definitions.de: Zeremonie oder Prozession, oft religiöser oder kultureller Natur in der laotischen Tradition
definitions.en: A ceremonial procession or ritual, often religious or cultural in Lao tradition
definitions.es: Procesión ceremonial o ritual, generalmente de naturaleza religiosa o cultural en la tradición laosiana
definitions.fr: Procession cérémonielle ou rituel, souvent de nature religieuse ou culturelle dans la tradition laotienne
definitions.hi: लाओ परंपरा में धार्मिक या सांस्कृतिक समारोह या जुलूस
definitions.ja: ラオスの伝統における宗教的または文化的な儀式や行列
definitions.km: ពិធីជាន់ដំណើរ ឬពិធីបុណ្យ ដែលជាញឹកញាប់មានលក្ខណៈសាសនា ឬវប្បធម៌នៅក្នុងប្រពៃណីឡាវ
definitions.ko: 라오스 전통에서 종교적 또는 문화적 성격의 의식 행렬이나 의례
definitions.ne: लाओ परम्परामा धार्मिक वा सांस्कृतिक प्रकृतिको औपचारिक जुलुस वा अनुष्ठान
definitions.pt: Procissão cerimonial ou ritual, geralmente de natureza religiosa ou cultural na tradição laosiana
definitions.th: ขบวนแห่พิธีกรรมหรือพิธีกรรม มักเป็นเรื่องทางศาสนาหรือวัฒนธรรมในประเพณีลาว
definitions.tl: Isang seremonyal na prusisyon o ritwal, kadalasang relihiyoso o kultural sa tradisyon ng Laos
definitions.ur: لاؤ روایت میں مذہبی یا ثقافتی نوعیت کا رسمی جلوس یا تقریب
definitions.vi: Một đám rước nghi lễ hoặc nghi thức, thường mang tính chất tôn giáo hoặc văn hóa trong truyền thống Lào
definitions.zh: 老挝传统中具有宗教或文化性质的仪式游行或典礼
definitions.zh_Hant: 老撾傳統中具有宗教或文化性質的儀式遊行或典禮

definition_en: A ceremonial procession or ritual, often religious or cultural in Lao tradition
